submitted.rationale: This is the highest measured EQE (0.064%). It sits at the Ag:Sb 1:1 composition of the known AgSbO3 phase. Merit falls off on both sides: the Ag-rich end (index 0) gave 0.034% and the Sb-rich index 7 near Ag7Sb9O25 gave 0.0009%.

rejected.reason: Ag-rich end (Ag3SbO4/Ag oxide region) measured 0.034% EQE, about half of index 5.
Sb-rich index near Ag7Sb9O25 measured about 0.001% EQE, so the Sb-rich side looks poor.
